messages:
julia: quick sync on pinning schema follow-up. goal: tiny hot-path wire, full control-plane shape, and clear compat rules.

omar: +1. two non-negotiables: servers ignore unknown fields; clients tolerate missing fields.

li: propose wire short keys: k=kind (hard|soft), s=scope (model|variant|tenant), v=version, l=lease(RFC3339|null), o=origin, x=observer_ids(array), sv=schema_version. control-plane keeps expanded keys including overrides and reason.

julia: example wire payload: ```{"k":"soft","s":"model","v":"m-20261001-ab12","l":"2027-01-01T00:00:00Z","o":"rollout-svc:v5","x":["edge-a"],"sv":2}```

omar: UX note from design-bot: UI must never show single-letter keys. Console should expand keys server-side before rendering. design-bot: will add mapping table.

li: runtime plan: ship tiny parsers (Go/Python/Node) that accept both compact and expanded forms and canonicalize to expanded map for downstream. parsers will set defaults: k=soft, l=null, sv=1 when absent.

sre-bot: created TASK PIN-701 for compat harness and TASK PIN-702 for runtime parsers.

julia: decision: adopt compact wire keys for hot RPCs; require sv for feature gates; control-plane accepts expanded JSON for admin flows; provide parser libs and Console expansion.

omar: action items: julia -> add migration checklist; li -> PR for parsers; design-bot -> Console mock & mapping. target: RFC draft update next Tue.

li: quick question: should we include a small provenance token on wire? suggestion: ptx short key for provenance id (small). else use origin.

julia: include ptx optional, but note size budget. prefer origin for most cases, ptx only for cross-service tracing.

omar: thanks all :thumbsup:
